title: Units, concentrations and ratios - 123 school
heading: Units, concentrations and ratios
intro: All the data you need is in the question. Every question tells you how to round.

questions.question: What does a concentration of 0.25 mol/L mean?

answers.b: 1 L of solution contains 0.25 mol of dissolved substance
answers.c: 0.25 L of solution contains 1 mol of dissolved substance
